title: Civil Engineer (Plant Infrastructure & Industrial Projects)
description:
**Civil Engineer (Plant Infrastructure & Industrial Projects)**

**Location:** Howrah

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**About Us** :

Royal Balaji Engineering Pvt Ltd is a premier manufacturer of high-precision industrial fasteners, nuts, bolts, specialized fitting items, and GI items. We supply critical, high-strength components to the automotive, heavy machinery, and large-scale infrastructure sectors.

**Position Overview** We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced **Civil Engineer** to oversee our manufacturing facility's infrastructure, manage plant expansions, and design heavy-duty structural foundations for our specialized production machinery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, plan, and oversee the construction and maintenance of factory floors, warehouses, and administrative facilities.
* Engineer specialized structural foundations capable of withstanding heavy vibrations from cold-heading presses, thread-rolling machines, and heat-treatment furnaces.
* Conduct regular structural audits of manufacturing units, storage racking systems, and overhead material handling equipment.
* Ensure all construction and facility operations comply with local building codes, and environmental regulations.
* Manage civil contractors, oversee material procurement, track project timelines, and maintain strict budgetary control.
* Collaborate with production and plant engineering teams to optimize shop-floor layouts and streamline internal material flow.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.
* 5 to 7 years of proven experience handling civil infrastructure projects within an industrial or heavy manufacturing environment.
* Strong expertise in structural design, geotechnical assessment, and dynamic foundation analysis.
* Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, or Revit.
* Excellent project management, problem-solving, and vendor-negotiation skills.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary with performance incentives.
* Professional development opportunities in a rapidly growing manufacturing sector.

*To apply, please submit your resume and a brief overview of your relevant industrial infrastructure experience.*

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Howrah, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC

Work Location: In person

title: Project Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Find your next move at JLL & build a fulfilling career.
  
  
At JLL, the Project Engineer supports the Project Lead in managing and executing civil engineering projects. This role involves assisting with project coordination, technical oversight, and team management to ensure successful delivery of civil works within scope, budget, and timeline. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in civil engineering and excellent project management skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Assist the Project Lead in planning, coordinating, and overseeing civil engineering projects.
  
Help develop and review electrical system designs, specifications, and drawings.
  
Support in managing project schedules, budgets, and resources effectively.
  
Coordinate with internal teams, subcontractors, and clients.
  
Conduct site visits to monitor installation progress and ensure compliance with design specifications.
  
Assist in preparing technical reports, change orders, and project documentation.
  
Help identify and mitigate potential project risks and issues related to electrical systems.
  
Support quality control processes and ensure adherence to electrical safety standards and codes.
  
Contribute to client presentations and progress meetings.
  
Support the procurement process for civil equipment and materials.
  
Help prepare project proposals and cost estimates for civil systems.
  
  
**Qualifications:**  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
  
3-5 years of experience in civil engineering projects.
  
Strong knowledge of civil works.
  
Have understanding of PEB works.
  
Proficiency in civil design software (e.g., AutoCAD civil).
  
Familiarity with relevant civil codes, standards, and regulations.
  
Experience with project management tools and methodologies.
  
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
  
Detail-oriented with good organizational skills
  
  
**Desired Skills:**  
Knowledge of civil design practices. Understanding of construction methodologies and site management.
  
Sequencing of PEB construction works.
  
  
**What We Offer:**  
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  
Exposure to diverse and challenging electrical engineering projects.
  
Commitment to sustainability and corporate social responsibility.
  
At JLL, we are dedicated to shaping the future of real estate for a better world. Join our team and be part of creating innovative electrical engineering solutions that make a difference.
  
JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive work environment that embraces diversity and fosters belonging. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
  
To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter through our careers portal.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**The Role**

***As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley*** , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

* Good Communication \& Presentation skills.
* High on initiative \& Drive.
* Analytical skills.
* Team Player.
* Urge to learn.
* Team Management

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* A degree engineering from a reputed university.

* Good Presentation Skills.

Mention near term mobility readiness.

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**About us**

  

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Purpose** : To lead the Project Controls team and manage all project planning, scheduling and cost management activities to ensure that projects are completed on time, on budget and required project services are delivered to Worley, and its client’s requirements.


**The Role**

***As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Lead the team, manage employee development and support career progression for the function.
* Ensure the services the team deliver meet project requirements to specified quality, on time and are within budget.
* Drive a culture of accountability within the group and enforce necessary measures when performance is inadequate.
* Drive a culture of ‘doing it right first time’ and delivering high quality deliverables that are part of fit for purpose solutions.
* Drive adoption of GID’s new way of operating.
* Build capability in the function to match capability needs identified by Works Management.
* Support implementation of a high performance delivery and unified GID organisational culture which spans across geographic locations and cultures.
* When necessary, perform project controls services.
* Ensure Continuous Improvement through the implementation of an Annual Improvement Plan and addressing lessons learnt.
* Develop, implement, improve and maintain Worley project controls systems, processes, practices and procedures.
* Review proposals for suitability of project scope, cost and scheduling requirements and coordinates development of all data in support of negotiations in line with Worley guidelines.
* Review Control budgets prepared for the projects and monitor deviation of the project cost with respect to the budgets prepared.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Interface with Project Management and Finance and Governance to prepare monthly internal reports, project control statements and MPRD reports.
* Partner with Workforce Planning to forecast personnel needs for projects.
* Liaise with other departments at meetings relative to project operations, to ensure that information affecting the project plan is continually updated.
* Proactively resolve any discrepancies between Worley and client’s requirements.
* Keep up to date with developments and innovations in the function.
* Demonstrate commitment to Zero Harm through regular actions and courageously speak up if work is being performed unsafely.
* Take accountability for own development and support the learning of others in areas of own experience by providing support to them as they are learning.
* Take initiative to get things done and do things before being asked by others.
* Apply standard procedures and processes to consistently deliver individual and team goals.
* Actively demonstrate WorleyParsons values and beliefs.
* Undertake any other reasonable duties as requested from time to time by the leadership team.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* 15\+ years of technical, practical and leadership experience in Project Controls in the same or similar industry, managing and leading large multi\-disciplinary projects and teams including 10\+ years of experience as project controls engineer / project planning engineer in engineering delivery organisation.
* Recognised degree in the relevant area or equivalent qualification/experience.
* Commercial experience, including contracts and procurement.
* Competent in the use of Primavera software package, Microsoft Excel, Access and other project controls specific software like PRA, Fuse etc.
* Able to make difficult decisions and lead others in changing business conditions.
* Can manage and resolve conflict between individuals and/or groups.
* Strong in negotiation of successful outcomes that achieve the required objectives and have the support and acceptance of all parties.

**Generic competencies:**

* Able to influence others, think ‘on your feet’ and have ability to work as part of a high performing team.
* Able to work effectively in small multi\-disciplinary teams, and share and transfer knowledge within teams.
* Able to share information to diverse audiences.
* Can listen and ask questions to ensure understanding.
* Able to use effective cross\-cultural communication skills.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
